node.title: H3 quotient-orbit Taylor-content support compiler
node.statement: For each canonical quotient block q_O, let C_O,35(X)=Res_T(q_O,sum_(i=0)^35 Pcal_n^[i](T)X^i). This polynomial is nonzero, and the odd radical of its coefficient content equals the odd radical of the exact block scalar annihilator. Thus one Taylor-resultant content per block gives exact cutoff-35 prime support without Smith form or three-resultant false positives. At n=8192 there are 24,534 blocks, maximum T-degree 4,096 and maximum X-degree 143,360. No valuation, implementation, coefficient, resource, factorization, moment, or C36 bound is claimed.
